# Valence

> Valence is a free, browser-based equity-valuation and 3-statement financial-modeling workbench for US (NASDAQ/NYSE) and Indian (NSE/BSE) equities, with DCF/WACC, trading comps, PE returns, and a 30-tab Excel exporter.

## Overview
- [Valence Home](https://valence-valuation.vercel.app/): Interactive valuation dashboard with company search, driver overrides, scenario modeling, QA report, and in-app methodology breakdowns.

## Capabilities
- DCF & WACC Engine: unlevered FCFF discounted at a CAPM-based WACC with Gordon-growth and exit-multiple terminal values.
- Reverse DCF: closed-form solve for market-implied perpetuity growth and revenue CAGR.
- Trading Comps & Football Field: peer benchmarking (EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF yield, ROIC) and cross-method valuation ranges.
- PE Returns & IRR: 3- and 5-year exit equity value, MoIC, and IRR across Base/Bull/Bear scenarios.
- Excel Exporter: 30-tab .xlsx workbook with live, dynamic Excel formulas.
- 9-Point QA Engine: automated balance-sheet, cash-flow, debt, share-count, and DCF bridge validation checks.
